correctness.rationale: A subgroup outside V projects onto C_q, and its intersection with V is invariant under the full prime-order complement, hence is 0 or V by irreducibility. The zero case is a complement and the V case is G. Fixed-point-freeness gives exactly p^r complements. Every nonzero proper subspace permutes with all subspaces and G but with no complement; a complement permutes only with 1, V, itself, and G. These exhaustive partner counts produce each displayed fraction. The packaged replay reconstructs the subgroup lists and set-product permutability matrices in three examples.

originality.rationale: The primary 2018 source defines and studies the same relative invariant, but its explicit semidirect-product formulas use cyclic normal kernels. The noncyclic elementary abelian rank-r family requires a different invariant-subspace argument. Related ZM-group work likewise assumes cyclic Sylow subgroups. Targeted semantic and exact-phrase searches found no full relative-degree formula for irreducible elementary-abelian Frobenius groups.

value.rationale: The relative subgroup commutativity function is a published invariant with an established program of classifying its value distribution. The result gives a full closed description on a natural infinite noncyclic-kernel Frobenius family rather than a single example. It reveals a dimension stratification through subspace counts, supplies the global subgroup commutativity degree as a corollary, and extends cyclic-kernel semidirect-product calculations to a genuinely projective subgroup lattice.
